title: Terms of Service
meta: Version 1.0 · Document date: 11 August 2026 · Effective when this version is published on go-irl.fun

body:
1. Who provides the service

GO IRL at go-irl.fun is operated by Пашин Виталий Викторович, Masarykova třída 10, Olomouc, Czech Republic. Contact: Vitvolny26@gmail.com (the “GO IRL” or the “operator”).

GO IRL is an online service for discovering, creating, sharing and coordinating local activities and real-life meetups. The current version is a free beta service. These Terms do not approve or govern future payments, subscriptions, marketplace functions or other commercial features.

2. Age and eligibility

The current closed beta version of GO IRL is intended only for persons aged 18 or over. When activating an account, the user expressly confirms that they are at least 18 years old. This confirmation is the user’s own declaration and is not age verification using an identity document or another verified-age system.

If GO IRL receives credible information that a user may be under 18, access to the account may be temporarily restricted while the situation is assessed in a proportionate manner. This beta version does not offer parental or guardian consent as an alternative to the 18+ requirement.

3. Account and sign-in

Some public content may be available without an account. Protected actions may require sign-in and completion of onboarding. GO IRL may allow sign-in through external providers such as Google, Facebook or Telegram where the relevant sign-in method is actually active.

Activating a GO IRL account may also require a name, a unique username, confirmation of 18+ eligibility and acceptance of these Terms. The user is responsible for the accuracy of information they provide and for protecting access to their account.

4. Public content and profile

Some information may be public, including a username, the public part of a profile, publicly created activities and information the user expressly publishes. A user must not unlawfully disclose another person’s personal data.

A public activity card may be available without sign-in. Access to protected data or functions, such as joining an activity, requesting to join or accessing a protected precise location, may require authentication and server-side authorization.

5. Creating activities and the organizer

A user who creates an activity is responsible for the reasonable accuracy and lawfulness of the information they publish, for having the right to use published content and for reasonably organizing the activity. GO IRL does not automatically become the organizer of a user’s physical activity merely because it provides the technical platform.

6. Joining, requests and participation

GO IRL may support direct joining or a request-to-join flow depending on the activity settings. Sending a request does not guarantee acceptance, and a “joined” status does not guarantee that the activity or a particular participation will actually take place.

The user is responsible for their own decision to attend a physical activity and should reasonably assess the place, organizer, other participants and circumstances.

7. Communication and chat

If GO IRL provides chat or another communication tool, the user may use it only in accordance with these Terms. Harassment, threats, fraud, spam, discriminatory attacks and unlawful sharing of personal data are prohibited.

An ordinary organizer message in chat does not by itself constitute system authorization to access a protected precise location or other protected data.

8. Location

GO IRL may process approximate or precise location depending on the specific feature. The precise location of a public business or another safe public place may be published if this matches the activity settings. A private address or another sensitive precise location should be protected by default.

Access to a protected precise location may be limited to confirmed participants or made available only at a specified time. A share link or discovery listing does not by itself create a right to such access.

9. Prohibited conduct and content

In particular, it is prohibited to use the service for unlawful activity, threats, harassment, stalking, fraud, impersonation, distributing malicious code, bypassing security restrictions, unlawfully disclosing private or sensitive data, or distributing other unlawful content.

10. User content and licence

The user retains rights to content they submit to GO IRL. To the extent necessary to operate the service, the user grants the operator a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, technically reproduce, display, transmit and make that content available through GO IRL features, and to process it to the extent necessary for safety and moderation.

The licence does not transfer ownership of the content and does not authorize use of the content for unrelated advertising.

11. Moderation and reporting illegal content

GO IRL may reasonably restrict the visibility of or remove content and may restrict, suspend or terminate an account where necessary to comply with law, protect the service or users, or enforce these Terms.

If you believe specific content on GO IRL is illegal, during the beta you may send a notice to Vitvolny26@gmail.com. Please provide the exact URL or another unambiguous identifier of the content, the reason you consider it illegal, your name and email unless a legal exception applies, and a confirmation that, to the best of your knowledge and belief, the information provided is accurate and complete.

12. Safety of physical meetups

GO IRL facilitates contact between users but generally cannot guarantee the identity, conduct, intentions or safety of every user or every physical location. Users should exercise their own judgment and take reasonable safety precautions.

This provision does not limit the operator’s liability where such liability cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law.

13. External services

Sign-in, sharing or other functions may use third-party services. Those services are governed by their own terms and policies. GO IRL is responsible for its own processing of data received from those providers to the extent required by applicable law.

14. Availability and service changes

GO IRL is a beta service under development and may temporarily be unavailable, changed or supplemented. The operator does not guarantee uninterrupted availability. Material changes that require new legal information or consent will be addressed appropriately.

15. Account termination and data removal

A user may request account termination or exercise personal-data rights by contacting Vitvolny26@gmail.com. Account termination does not mean unconditional immediate deletion of every record where there is a lawful basis for limited further retention.

16. Liability

GO IRL is liable to the extent provided by applicable law. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits rights or liability that cannot be excluded under mandatory law.

17. Changes to the Terms

GO IRL may update these Terms when the service or legal requirements change. Users will be reasonably informed of material changes. The version and effective date will be published with the document, and renewed acceptance will be requested where legally required.

18. Governing law and contact

These Terms are governed by the law of the Czech Republic, subject to any mandatory rights the user may have under applicable European Union law or other mandatory law.

Questions about the Terms: Vitvolny26@gmail.com.
